notes: Budget of 30 searches/fetches used in full. Reddit search.json returned HTML (blocked) for all four subs, so zero Reddit items. Stack Overflow returned 2 irrelevant hits. HN returned 137 hits; about 25 mention Diners Club, most from a cardholder or history angle and excluded; 5 kept, all by commenters whose role is not stated (coded developer by platform). GitHub returned 537 hits; the top 50 are mostly card-validation/BIN-range code (e.g., langchain#40000, hyperswitch#14042) about third-party libraries, not sentiment about the network; 2 kept. Web searches surfaced mostly PSP docs and network marketing. In-window named-partner quotes were scarce: BDO (2016) and ABank (2015) franchise quotes fetched but are outside the window and dropped. RBA 2025 review material reports Diners domestic average merchant service fee of 1.66% (Sept 2024) vs 0.76-0.78% for Visa/Mastercard credit, and notes Diners falls outside the surcharge ban. This came only from a search summary, not a verbatim fetch, so it is not coded as an item; it is the best lead for institutional/merchant follow-up. Other unfollowed leads: Moorwand UK acquiring expansion and ISX/Flykk pan-European franchise (2025). Capital One-Discover merchant commentary found concerned Discover debit, not Diners. Balance rule: only the developer audience has both favourable-less critical items; no favourable developer item found. Wayback lookups returned no snapshots for GitHub/HN URLs.
